newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $945 mln in October's second week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $945 mln in October's second week.

text.p: Brazil exported $945 million in goods in the second week of October, with average daily exports reaching $189 million, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
In the first week of the month, the daily average reached $219.4 million.
The spokeswoman said the second week's results brought total exports for October so far to $1.603 billion, with the daily average at $204 million.
September exports totalled $4.115 billion, averaging $196 million a day. The September trade balance was due to be announced sometime this week.
